author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
Only turn it on if you're inventory is getting cluttered from broken and common quality accessories. Nothing worse than having to sort through a sell 100 broken red gems, gadgets, monster tomes, etc.

VERY IMPORTANT point here though:

If you're trying to get accessories for a certain quest, like the Enlightened King and Queen quest, make sure this is turned off!! You wouldn't believe how many kings and queens I killed trying to get those dang items, I thought the drop rate was non-existent! Then I figured I had auto drop on.... 😅😅

Same story when I was trying to go for Trevalyn's Charm from the raid boss or Lugus gauntlets....so many chances to get a good quality version of those wasted due to me haphazardly dropping all the accessories 😂😂😭😭
